items.description: One entry per substantive agenda item, decision, expenditure, repair, dispute or financial report in the minutes. Skip attendance, apologies and confirmation of previous minutes.

meeting_date.description: Date of the meeting this item belongs to, ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

asset.description: Physical asset or area concerned, short noun phrase (e.g. 'roof', 'Nielsen Park wharf', 'garden seats'). Empty string if none.

summary.description: One plain-English sentence describing what happened or was decided.

amount_aud.description: Dollar amount attached to this item in AUD, if any. Use the single most relevant figure; 0 if none.

status.description: Outcome of the item at this meeting. Use 'deferred' when action is postponed or left pending, 'unresolved' when a problem is raised with no resolution.

counterparty.description: Contractor, agency or person the item involves (e.g. 'R. Contato', 'National Parks Service'). Empty string if none.

red_flag.description: True if a prospective buyer, funder or auditor should worry about this: deferred or disputed maintenance, structural problems, funding shortfalls, cost overruns, legal disputes, safety or insurance issues, unclear responsibility for repairs.

red_flag_reason.description: If red_flag is true, a short reason. Otherwise empty string.
